headline: Nigerian Naira Remains Under Pressure Despite Foreign Reserve Growth
summary: The Nigerian naira continues to face exchange rate pressure against the U.S. dollar despite the country accumulating its highest level of foreign exchange reserves in years.
why: Foreign currency liquidity and naira stability are crucial for managing domestic inflation and balance of payments in Africa's largest economy.

impacts.name: Nigerian Naira
impacts.why: The currency remains under market pressure despite rising central bank foreign currency reserves.
